================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO YE AFTER EFFECTS - ZVITSVA
Vhezheni 9.2.8  -  Gumiguru 2026
================================================================================

Panel ikozvino inotaura MITAURO 132, kune MATHEME matsva eDEMON SLAYER ane
munondo unocheka mabhatani aunodzvanya, uye zvigadziriso zvishoma zve layout neWindows.

USATI WATANGA
- Isa pamusoro pevhezheni yaunayo ikozvino uchishandisa ZXP installer yako yenguva dzose, wobva
  wavhura After Effects zvakare kamwe chete.
- Marongero ako, theme, ma-preset nema-expression awakachengeta zvose zvinochengetedzwa.

ZVITSVA: PANEL MUMITAURO 132
- Flex Marongero > MUTAURO ikozvino ine mitauro 132, pamwe chete nebhokisi rekutsvaga. Sarudza
  mumwe uye panel yose inoshanduka: matabhu, mabhatani, ma-tooltip, mameseji.
- Mutauro wega wega wakashandurwa neAI kubva papanel yeChirungu, kwete izwi
  neizwi. Mazita aunoona mu-project yako (mazita e-layer, mazita e-effect) anoramba
  ari muChirungu kuti arambe achienderana neAfter Effects.
- Popup ye“Zvitsva” yakashandurwawo, kutanga nevhezheni iyi.

ZVITSVA: MATHEME EDEMON SLAYER
- Flex Marongero > KUSARUDZA THEME ine boka idzva reDEMON SLAYER rine matheme 11:
  Giyu, Hinokami Kagura, Shinobu, Mitsuri, Rengoku, Zenitsu, Nezuko,
  Muichiro, Inosuke, Tengen naKokushibo.
- Fambisa mouse pamusoro pepanel uye chinhu chetheme chinoiteverera: mvura,
  murazvo, mheni, mabutterfly, mashizha emaruva, mhute nezvimwe. Mouse
  painomira, chinonyangarika zvishoma nezvishoma.
- Dzvanya bhatani uye munondo wemunhu iyeye unoricheka. Ramba wakabata bhatani
  rekuruboshwe uye unoramba uchicheka; uribate kwemasekonzi anenge 2.5 uye rinoputika.
- Yakagadzirwa kuti irambe isina kurema: maeffect anongoshanda kana uchifambisa mouse kana kudzvanya, uye
  anozviita asina kurema pamakomputa anononoka. Dzima MAEFFECT ANOTENDEREDZA
  muKusarudza Theme kuti uchengete mavara chete.

SHANDURO: MABHATANI AKAENZANA MUTHEME ZVOSE
- Mabhatani anoshanda uye makuru mumatheme ane mavara haachashandisi gradient
  ine mumvuri kubva kumusoro kusvika pasi. Ava ane ruvara rumwe chete rwakaenzana nechiedza chakapfava, saka
  anotaridzika akachena uye anoverengeka nyore.

ZVAGADZIRISWA
- Kadhi rerezinesi uye popup ye“Zvitsva” zvaigona kuvhurika chimwe pamusoro
  pechimwe. Ikozvino hazvichambofukidzana, uye badge reKUGADZIRIDZA harichafukidzi
  mabhatani ari kumusoro kwepanel.
- Paukuru hwe-UI hwe125% ne150%, mawindo mamwe (seFlex Marongero) aigona kureba
  kupfuura panel, saka bhatani rekuvhara raibuda pachiratidziro. Hwindo
  rimwe nerimwe ikozvino rinokwana pakukura kwese.
- Windows: AutoCaptions yaigona kuti "DRIVER YENVIDIA YAKARE ZVAKANYANYA PAMA-CAPTION
  EGPU" pamakadhi matsva nema-driver matsva (RTX 40 ne50 series). Ikozvino inoverenga
  rutsigiro rweCUDA rwedriver nemazvo uye inoshandisa GPU yako.

ZVISINA KUSHANDURWA
- Rezinesi, activation uye lingi rega rega zvinoshanda zvakafanana nepakutanga.
- Tabhu imwe neimwe yasara nechishandiso chega chega zvinoshanda zvakafanana nemuvhezheni 9.2.7.
================================================================================

ult.message:
FLEX ULTIMATE YE PREMIERE PRO - ZVITSVA
Vhezheni 2.2.8  -  Gumiguru 2026

Ma-caption eCAPTION STACK ikozvino ndiwo matemplate eMotion Graphics ANOGONA KUGADZIRISWA ane
editor chaiyo, kune AUDIO STUDIO itsva neMARK AUDIO BEATS, panel inotaura MITAURO 132,
UKURU HWE-UI hunouya muULTIMATE, uye kune MATHEME matsva eDEMON SLAYER.

USATI WATANGA
- Isa pamusoro pevhezheni yaunayo ikozvino uchishandisa ZXP installer yako yenguva dzose, wobva
  wavhura Premiere Pro zvakare kamwe chete.
- Marongero ako, theme nema-preset zvose zvinochengetedzwa.

ZVITSVA: CAPTION STACK - MA-CAPTION ANOGONA KUGADZIRISWA (FX & ADV RIGS > CAPTION STACK)
- Ma-caption ikozvino anoiswa sematemplate eMotion Graphics anogona kugadziriswa (Zvinobuda >
  MOGRT ANOGONA KUGADZIRISWA, ndiyo default itsva muPremiere Pro 2026). Mushure mekuaisa,
  shandura izwi ripi zvaro, font, ruvara, ukuru, nzvimbo, glow, outline, bhokisi,
  animation kana nguva muEssential Graphics panel yePremiere.
- Zvinobuda > MIFANANIDZO ichiisa izwi rega rega semufananidzo une chitarisiko chakafanana
  chaizvo, kana ndizvo zvaunoda.
- Matemplate anouya nepanel. Hapana chekudhawunirodha.

ZVITSVA: CAPTION STACK EDITOR
- Preview ikozvino inoratidza frame chaiyo yevhidhiyo yako pasi pecaption imwe neimwe.
- Dhonza caption kuti uifambise, shandisa kona kuchinja ukuru nepoindi iri kumusoro
  kuitenderedza, dzvanya kaviri pazwi kuti uriedit. CAPTION YOSE inofambisa mazwi ose
  pamwe chete, IZWI RIMWE inofambisa izwi rimwe chete.
- Sarudza kuti shanduko iiswe pama-caption ose here kana pacaption iyi chete, uye
  chengeta layout dzako kuti uzvishandise zvakare.
- Maonekedzo matsva 10 eGLOW: Big Wide, Bounce Lime, Candy, Horror, Hook, Typewriter,
  Editorial, Sunset, Slide Yellow naSuperb.

ZVITSVA: AUDIO STUDIO (FX & ADV RIGS > AUDIO STUDIO)
- Sarudza audio clip, sarudza effect wobva wadzvanya SHANDISA. Zvose zvinoshanda
  pakomputa yako.
- 30 presets dzekudzvanya kamwe: Underwater, Bass Boost, Room / Hall / Cathedral /
  Plate reverb, Echo, Telephone, Radio, Megaphone, Robot, Chipmunk, Deep
  Voice, Nightcore, Slowed + Reverb, 8D Audio, Lo-fi, Reverse nezvimwe. Isa
  maeffect akawanda sezvaunoda, uaronge zvakare, kana udzime rimwe.
- Reverb inochengeta muswe wayo: ruzha runoramba runonzwika kupfuura pakupera kweclip, uye
  runoiswa kuti hapana chiri patimeline yako chinonyorwa pamusoro.
- Zvishandiso: Kubvisa Ruzha, Kusimbisa Izwi, Loudness (-14 / -16 / -23 LUFS),
  De-esser, De-click, De-clip, Kubvisa Hum, Compressor, Limiter, EQ, Speed
  nePitch, Noise Gate, Kutora Audio.
- STEMS MAKER inopatsanura rwiyo kuita izwi rekuimba nemimhanzi (kana ma-stem mana). Inodhawunirodha
  model yayo kekutanga uye inokubvunza kutanga.
- PREVIEW inokubvumira kunzwa masekonzi anenge 8 une switch yeOriginal / Processed.
  Mhedzisiro inoiswa paaudio track isina chinhu uye clip yako yepakutanga inonyararidzwa,
  haidzimwi.

ZVITSVA: MARK AUDIO BEATS (FX & ADV RIGS > MARK AUDIO BEATS)
- Sarudza music clip patimeline woudzvanya MARK BEATS: Flex inowana
  mabeats uye inoisa sequence markers pamusoro pawo, kuitira kuti ma-cut ako akwane
  chaizvo pamimhanzi.
- Sarudza ZVOSE hits, KICKS kana SNARES, isa sensitivity, uye maka beat rega rega kana
  beat yechipiri nechipiri kana yechina nechina.
- REMOVE BEAT MARKERS inobvisa chete markers dzakaiswa neFlex. Inoshanda
  pakomputa yako.

ZVITSVA: PANEL MUMITAURO 132
- Marongero > MUTAURO ikozvino ine mitauro 132, pamwe chete nebhokisi rekutsvaga. Matabhu,
  mabhatani, ma-tooltip nemameseji zvose zvinoshanduka. Popup ye“Zvitsva”
  yakashandurwawo, kutanga nevhezheni iyi.

ZVITSVA: UKURU HWE-UI
- Marongero > UKURU HWE-UI hunoita kuti panel yose ive hombe kana diki, sezvazvakaita
  muFlex GUI Pro. Hwindo rimwe nerimwe rinokwana pakukura kwese.
